harper: Following the postmortem, we need concise owners + short timelines for GPU headroom & autoscale actions. Trying to lock today.

noah: I can own scheduler tuning. Quick scope: add preempt debounce, raise min_idle, disable aggressive reclaim for 2h windows.

lee: I'll own quota & reserve pool: propose a 6% reserved pool for premium/system workloads with opt-out. Add rollback flag.

ops-bot: Created tasks: GPU-1601 (scheduler-debounce), GPU-1602 (reserve-pool + opt-out), GPU-1603 (alerts + runbooks), GPU-1604 (surge-ci-job).

harper: Proposed owners + deadlines:
- noah -> GPU-1601 scheduler debounce PR -> 2026-03-29
- lee -> GPU-1602 reserve pool + opt-out -> 2026-04-04
- harper -> GPU-1603 alert thresholds + runbook -> 2026-03-27
- lee -> GPU-1604 synthetic surge CI job -> 2026-03-26

noah: Scheduler draft changes (short):
```
preempt_debounce_s: 6
min_idle_slots_per_node: 2
aggressive_reclaim: disabled for 2h post-rollout
```
I'll open a PR with perf dashboards and a 6h canary plan.

lee: Reserve pool: 6% cluster GPUs, per-tenant opt-out toggle, immediate rollback flag. Target one-region rollout first. Will add admin console toggle ticket (ADMIN-109).

harper: Alerts: warning at 80% committed GPUs, critical at 94%. Runbook steps: scale noncritical down, enable reserve pool, contact infra lead. I'll add Slack warning channel and pager at critical.

finance: Finance notes: temporary headroom approved for up to 5 weeks if cost delta <10%. Need final rollback language.

sre-oncall: For canaries, invite us to validation window. Health gates: preemptions <= baseline*1.25, tail 95p latency <= +12%.

noah: I'll include an automated gate: if preemptions/hr >5 during canary, auto-disable changes.

lee: CI surge job: 20m mixed-sequence spike with KV warmup; fail on alert regressions. Will run nightly for 10 days after rollout.

harper: Recurring check-ins: weekly 15m incident-pattern sync for 4 weeks. ops-bot please create calendar entry.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-25T17:00Z.

harper: Thanks — I'll update the postmortem follow-ups doc and ping owners tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

noah: ack.

lee: ack.
